title: National Commission's Jurisdiction over Other Values of Goods and Services

content.scenario: The Central Government prescribes a value of goods and services for the National Commission's jurisdiction, which is different from the standard value of Rs. 10 crore.
content.outcome: The National Commission has jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of goods or services paid as consideration is as prescribed by the Central Government, as per Section 101(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the jurisdiction of the National Commission over complaints of other values?
Can the Central Government prescribe a different value for the National Commission's jurisdiction?
What are the conditions for the National Commission to exercise jurisdiction over other values?
